label: Virginia State Legislative Squadron
size_basis: estimated typical embroidered patch width 3 in (group, squadron and activity patches 3 in); the official digital artwork carries no physical size; height follows the artwork's own aspect
citation: CAPR 39-1 para 10.9 / Attachment 8 define the patch but give no dimensions

ground_removed.colour: none: the ground was already clear

provenance: Unit emblem of Virginia State Legislative Squadron (MAR-VA-999), digital artwork sent by the owner, 2026-11-18, as the unit's official digital emblem. Official digital artwork shipped as given: png (8-bit RGBA), 562 x 577 px, 8-bit RGBA; the file came with its ground already clear and a hard edge with no semi-transparent pixel at all, so no pixel was changed; the picture was trimmed to the emblem's box (562 x 577 px to 482 x 550 px); every pixel inside the emblem's outline is untouched; no resampling, no redrawing, no tracing, no other colour change. Charter: 999 is printed on the emblem (VA-999) and is the builder's unit list number of the Virginia State Legislative Squadron, MAR-VA-999; the wing site has a page for the Legislative Squadron.
notes: Official digital artwork as given, not a redraw: no thread texture added, nothing re-drawn or re-coloured. The only change is the trim to the emblem's box.
